peak_rss_attribution: process-lifetime VmHWM including warm-up; not per-run
alloc_attribution: case-level counting allocator delta including warm-up, reps and witness

counter_semantics.validator_read_bytes: exact logical bytes pulled through the csv-crate validator handle (CountingReader); includes the header re-check read
counter_semantics.decoder_os_bytes: recorded full-file size for the mmap-backed Polars decoder; handle/OS-level, NOT exact logical read bytes
counter_semantics.inference_phase_bytes: exact logical bytes read by the bounded schema-inference pass
counter_semantics.csv_rows_decoded: row heights of the Polars-decoded frames
counter_semantics.csv_rows_validated: records read by the csv-crate lockstep validator
counter_semantics.csv_fail_decode: 1 if the Polars decode stage raised the terminating error
counter_semantics.csv_fail_validate: 1 if the validation stage raised the terminating error
counter_semantics.ingest_inspect_nanos: wall time of the bounded inspect/inference stage
counter_semantics.ingest_prepare_nanos: wall time of the delimited prepare segment (validator build, header re-check, Polars batched-reader construction)
counter_semantics.ingest_decode_nanos: consumer-side wall time blocked in Polars next_batches; Polars may decode ahead on its own threads, so this is a blocking-time observation, not exclusive CPU time
counter_semantics.ingest_validate_nanos: wall time of the csv-crate lockstep validation for the same frames
